text:
leo: RFC idea: introduce an opt-in request header `X-Tenant-Context` to explicitly declare routing/quotas for edge cases where API key claims don't map cleanly. Less magic than claim-inference. Thoughts?
anita: This feels useful for multi-tenant infra jobs that need to route under a different logical tenant. Is the intent to change billing too or just routing/telemetry?
leo: Start with routing + metrics + soft quotas. Billing resolution stays tied to the key's billing_account unless the org flips the new billing mode. That keeps the migration non-breaking.
cory: Security gate: if header present we must verify the key is allowed to assert that tenant. New token claim `assume_tenants` or per-key ACL. Otherwise it's elevation.
leo: Exactly. Validation flow: gateway -> lookup allowed-tenants for key -> if allowed attach tenant metadata; if not allowed reject with 403 + audit event.
billing-aly: For exports we need deterministic columns: `resolved_tenant`, `tenant_override` (bool), and `billing_account_used`. Finance needs this to reconcile usage vs invoices.
leo: Example request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat 
  -H "Authorization: ApiKey sk_live_abc" 
  -H "X-Tenant-Context: partner-acme/test-env" 
  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

anita: Also propose a read-only header `X-Tenant-Context-Audit` for clients to surface intent without affecting routing. Helpful for telemetry before flipping to live routing.
cory: Good call. Gate the live header behind feature flag `tenant-context-v1` so default behavior unchanged. Canary by org flag.
billing-aly: How do quotas work? If routing uses tenant name for sharding, do we apply namespace quota there? If billing uses account from key, the quota/billing mismatch could confuse customers.
leo: Plan: apply soft quota at tenant level (reject only after soft threshold unless org opts in), always enforce hard quota at billing_account level until billing-mode is enabled. Console will show both counters side-by-side.
anita: Telemetry: add label `tenant_source` = claim|header_override|audit_only and `override_key_id`. Add a Grafana panel for override_ratio per org.
cory: Implementation tasks: gateway header parsing + tenant lookup, auth service check `assume_tenants`, routing layer plumb tenant -> model-pool, quota service soft-limit path, billing export fields.
leo: Edge cases: legacy keys without `assume_tenants` should be unaffected. Some internal infra uses ephemeral tokens from CI; ensure token exchange preserves allowed-tenants claim if present.
anita: Logging: create `tenant_override_attempt` events with shape {"key_id":"K_x","attempted_tenant":"T","ip":"...","decision":"allowed|denied"}. Keep copies in S3 for 90 days.
billing-aly: Add CSV fields `resolved_tenant`, `tenant_override` to billing export; we'll need a migration window for downstream consumers.
cory: Rollout propose: 1) audit-only header in canary (2 weeks) 2) header-as-routing with feature flag for whitelisted orgs (4 weeks) 3) open beta opt-in. Monitor `auth.denied_assume`, `tenant_override_rate`, `billing.mismatch_alerts`.
leo: Rate limiting: keep per-key rate limits, then apply tenant-tier shaping. Document that tenant shaping is coarse-grained (low-cardinality tiers) to avoid explosion in metric cardinality.
anita: SDKs: add helper to set audit-only header, but default SDKs should not set live routing header until org opt-in. Note: Gateway must enforce whitelist for downstream proxies (only accept header from public clients when key claim allows it).
leo: infra-bot: scheduled job to create dashboard skeleton and alert rules in staging at 2026-04-05T09:00Z.
infra-bot: Action queued: create grafana panel tenant_override_rate and alert if > 2x baseline within 10m.
billing-aly: We also need a Console checkbox "Allow API keys to assert tenant via header" per key to let org admins opt in. Show recent override history per key.
leo: Action items: @cory build gateway header parsing + auth check, @anita add telemetry labels + dashboard, @billing-aly add billing export fields + console toggle, I'll draft RFC doc with diagrams.
cory: I'll start a branch with gateway changes and unit tests for assume_tenants ACL.
anita: I'll add prometheus labels and a staging dashboard.
leo: Keep conservative default: audit-only until we validate metrics. Thanks all.
